title: Advancing Responsible Innovation in Agentic AI: A study of Ethical Frameworks for Household Automation
reasoning: The paper is entirely dedicated to the study, review, and proposal of ethical frameworks for AI. It goes far beyond a simple 'Ethical Considerations' section by making ethics the core subject of the research, focusing on five key ethical principles (beneficence, non-maleficence, autonomy, justice, and explicability) and their implementation in agentic systems.
